使用 Git Submodule 和直接存放源代码的混合方式处理依赖
https://sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530300.zip
git submodule add https://github.com/gabime/spdlog.git third_party/spdlog
git submodule add https://github.com/jbeder/yaml-cpp.git third_party/yaml-cpp
git submodule add https://github.com/openssl/openssl.git third_party/openssl
git submodule add https://github.com/grpc/grpc.git third_party/grpc
git submodule add https://github.com/boostorg/boost.git third_party/boost
cd third_party/boost
git submodule update --init --recursive
